sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा त्वभिनिर्यान्तं नगर्याः काननौकसः।उत्पेतुरभिसङ्क्रुद्धाः शिलाहस्ता युयुत्सवः ।। ६.८१.७ ।।
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā tvabhiniryāntaṁ nagaryāḥ kānanaukasaḥ।utpeturabhisaṅkruddhāḥ śilāhastā yuyutsavaḥ ।। 6.81.7 ।।

translations.english: All the forest animals perceiving Indrajithadvancing became angry and with rocks in hand faced him with enthusiasm.
